scope: Actual StableNet Linux build with every selected source file verified inside read-only bind, fresh ELF publication through setup.sh, Docker copy/version/hash on one owned server. Not three-chain/fleet15/fullL1/Linux mainnet/Web acceptance.
unitRed: Existing host ELF was accepted and copied when container output was missing; invalid/failed output overwrote the previous artifact. A first staging fix leaked its EXIT cleanup because Bash unwound locals, and a failed build leaving ELF bytes still passed command-substitution errexit. Those failures are retained. Resource propagation control was corrected after an initial test-fixture boolean-list mistake, then produced genuine RED.
unitGreen: Fresh output positive and four failure modes, no placement on failure, previous bytes preserved, own staging reclaimed, GOMAXPROCS/GOFLAGS propagated. Full resource/setup race and make check passed after final code.

firstAttempt.reason: Build/copy/version succeeded, but proof driver incorrectly equated tracked cleanliness with Go vcs.modified, which also includes preserved user untracked configuration. No product failure claimed. Both statuses split, metadata controls checked, actual run repeated with verified owned warm cache.
